name: Way of Madness
detailed_description:
In Way of Madness, you awaken in a remote cabin with no memory of your recent past—only scattered voice recordings and haunting visions to guide you. As a once-brilliant scientist, your descent into madness began with a single unethical choice: experimenting on humans instead of animals, driven by a hunger for discovery. But something went terribly wrong.

Now, fractured memories resurface. You hear yourself speaking, yet can’t recall the words. Hallucinations blur reality as you talk to inanimate objects, and monstrous reflections of your experiments stalk your every step. With your sanity unraveling, you must navigate a cosmic horror tale built on guilt, delusion, and irreversible mistakes.

Rendered entirely in hand-drawn 2D dark art, Way of Madness delivers a disturbing, immersive survival horror experience—where the greatest threat may lie within your own mind.

Key Features

  • Hand-Drawn Horror – Explore a richly illustrated 2D world soaked in dread and cosmic unease.

  • Psychological Unraveling – Experience hallucinations, twisted encounters, and unreliable narration as sanity crumbles.

  • Environmental Storytelling – Discover your forgotten past through found recordings and hidden clues.

  • Cosmic Survival Horror – Face barely-real horrors in a world warped by guilt, memory, and madness.
